acceptance: NB-005 is emitted from sql/validation/name_binding.rs, alongside NB-003, via a check called from validate_query_scope immediately after check_duplicate_relation_names

Two SELECT items emitting the same output name are rejected at plan time for: explicit duplicate aliases; a qualifier-strip collision (SELECT a.x, b.x); and a #1918 generated name colliding with an explicit alias

The emitted name of each select item is computed by #1918's SHARED naming helper — not re-derived, not copied. If the helper cannot be reached from validation/ it is MOVED to a shared module, never duplicated, and plan/ is not imported into validation/
collect_output_names is neither reused nor modified — it returns explicit AS aliases only and is blind to the qualifier-strip case this issue exists for

SelectField::Wildcard is skipped, with a code comment stating case 4 is out of scope and why (needs schema; SELECT alias.* does not parse, #1931). Non-wildcard siblings in the same select list are still checked against each other
Matching is case-insensitive (eq_ignore_ascii_case), consistent with check_duplicate_relation_names
The message names BOTH colliding items with 1-based select-list positions and gives a remedy; the generated-name case carries its own distinct guidance
NB-005 is an error, never a warning
The doc-example corpus gate stays green; if it reddens that is reported, not fixed by editing example SQL
New tests extend the existing name_binding_validation_test.rs and name_binding_error_message_test.rs; any new file is registered in the parent mod.rs
./run-commit.sh --fast is green, and any cargo fmt rewrite it applies is committed
forbidden: do not reuse or modify collect_output_names — it is the alias-reuse exemption helper, not an output-name helper
do not duplicate #1918's naming helper; call it, or move it to a shared module
do not import plan/ into validation/ — name_binding.rs is a pure AST walk with no schema, catalog or plan
do not implement case 4 (SELECT *, col) and do not move NB-005 into Schema::new
do not soften NB-005 to a warning
do not edit a SQL EXAMPLE under docs/ or demo/ to make a gate pass — report a red corpus instead, it most likely means #1918's generated names collide somewhere
do not write SELECT alias.* in a test expecting it to parse — it has no parser production (#1931)
do not add #[cfg(test)] or #[test] inside src/
do not delete, skip, #[ignore] or narrow any existing test
